greek: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν λέγων Ἰδοὺ δέδωκά σε θεὸν Φαραω, καὶ Ααρων ὁ ἀδελφός σου ἔσται σου προφήτης·
hint: The lord tells Moses he has made him a god to Pharaoh, with Aaron his brother as his prophet.

notes.text: I have given you as God to Pharaoh: θεόν without the article, the predicate; Φαραω, indeclinable, read as the dative, the Hebrew lĕparʿōh.
προφήτης, one who speaks for a god, for the Hebrew nābîʾ.

reading: and [[said|said, spoke, declared, called by name, told|λέγω]] [[lord|lord, master, the one having power and authority over|κύριος]] [[toward|toward, facing, oriented to, in living motion and address toward|πρός + accusative]] [[name:Μωυσῆν]] [[saying|saying, speaking, declaring, calling by name, telling|λέγω]] [[lo|lo, behold, see there|ἰδού]] [[I have given|I have given and it stands given, I have granted and it stands granted, I have provided and it stands provided, I have given over and delivered up and it stands so|δίδωμι]] you [[God|everything that God is by nature, deity in full and undiminished kind|θεός]] to [[name:Φαραω]], and [[name:Ααρων]] [[the son of the same mother|the son of the same mother, the brother, the near kinsman|ἀδελφός]] of you will be of you [[one who speaks for a God and interprets his will|one who speaks for a God and interprets his will, a prophet, an interpreter and declarer, an inspired preacher and teacher, the revealer of God's counsel for the future, a predicter of future events|προφήτης]];

names.gloss: (Μωυσῆς, from Hebrew Mōšeh, which the Hebrew of 2:10 hears in māšâ, "to draw out")
(Φαραω, from Hebrew Parʿōh, from the Egyptian for "great house")
(Ααρων, from Hebrew ʾAhărōn, of uncertain meaning)

greek: σὺ δὲ λαλήσεις αὐτῷ πάντα, ὅσα σοι ἐντέλλομαι, ὁ δὲ Ααρων ὁ ἀδελφός σου λαλήσει πρὸς Φαραω ὥστε ἐξαποστεῖλαι τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ ἐκ τῆς γῆς αὐτοῦ.
hint: Moses is to tell Aaron everything, and Aaron will speak to Pharaoh to release the sons of Israel.

notes.text: The name's own article, cut off by δέ: but, the Aaron.
So as to send away: the Hebrew has wĕšillaḥ, and he will send away.

reading: you [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], [[you will talk|you will talk, you will chat, you will prattle, you will babble, you will say, you will talk of, you will speak, you will chatter, you will chirp|λαλέω]] to him [[all|all, the whole, every, every single|πᾶς]], [[as great as|as great as, as much as, as far as, as long as, as many as|ὅσος]] to you [[I enjoin|I enjoin, I command|ἐντέλλομαι]], [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], the [[name:Ααρων]] [[the son of the same mother|the son of the same mother, the brother, the near kinsman|ἀδελφός]] of you [[will talk|will talk, will chat, will prattle, will babble, will say, will talk of, will speak, will chatter, will chirp|λαλέω]] [[toward|toward, facing, oriented to, in living motion and address toward|πρός + accusative]] [[name:Φαραω]] [[so as to|so as to, as to, on the condition that, and so and therefore and consequently, as and as being, since it was|ὥστε]] [[to send quite away|to send quite away, to dispatch|ἐξαποστέλλω]] the sons of [[name:Ισραηλ]] [[out of|out of, forth from, from|ἐκ]] [[of the earth|of the earth, of the land, of the ground|γῆ]] of him.

names.gloss: (Ισραηλ, from Hebrew Yiśrāʾēl, which the Hebrew of Genesis 32:29 hears in śārâ ʿim ʾĕlōhîm, "he strove with God")

greek: ἐγὼ δὲ σκληρυνῶ τὴν καρδίαν Φαραω καὶ πληθυνῶ τὰ σημεῖά μου καὶ τὰ τέρατα ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ.
hint: God will harden Pharaoh's heart and multiply his signs and wonders in Egypt.

notes.text: I will harden: the Hebrew has ʾaqšeh, I will make hard, as at 4:21 it had ʾăḥazzēq. σκληρύνω, Middle Liddell's one translation, plain text.
The name in the dative beside γῇ, as at 6:28.

reading: I [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], I will harden [[the heart|the heart, the stomach|καρδία]] of [[name:Φαραω]] and [[I will make full|I will make full and increase and multiply|πληθύνω]] [[the signs|the signs, the marks and tokens, the signs from the gods and the omens, the signals, the standards and ensigns, the boundaries|σημεῖον]] of me and [[the signs|the signs and wonders and marvels, the monsters|τέρας]] [[in earth|within, inside of, and by means of earth, land, ground|ἐν; γῆ]] to [[name:Αἰγύπτῳ]].

names.gloss: (Αἴγυπτος, the Greek name of the land; Hebrew Miṣrayim)

greek: καὶ οὐκ εἰσακούσεται ὑμῶν Φαραω· καὶ ἐπιβαλῶ τὴν χεῖρά μου ἐπʼ Αἴγυπτον καὶ ἐξάξω σὺν δυνάμει μου τὸν λαόν μου τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου σὺν ἐκδικήσει μεγάλῃ,
hint: When Pharaoh will not listen, God will lay his hand on Egypt and bring his people out with great vengeance.

notes.text: With my power, my force: the Hebrew has ʾet-ṣibʾōtay, my hosts.
With great avenging, for the Hebrew bišpāṭîm gĕdōlîm, with great judgments. ἐκδίκησις, an avenging, Middle Liddell's one translation, plain text.

reading: and not [[will hearken|will hearken and give ear to, will hear, will hearken to and give heed to|εἰσακούω]] of you [[name:Φαραω]]; and [[I will throw and cast upon|I will throw and cast upon, I will lay on, I will affix, I will add, I will mention, I will throw myself upon and go straight towards, I will fall upon and against, I will apply myself to and devote myself to, I will give my attention to and think on, I will follow and come next, I will belong to and fall to|ἐπιβάλλω]] [[the hand|the hand, the hand and arm, the arm|χείρ]] of me [[upon|upon, on, in, at, near|ἐπί + accusative]] [[name:Αἴγυπτον]] and [[I will lead out|I will lead out, I will lead and carry out from, I will bring forth into the world, I will march out, I will eject, I will carry out and export, I will draw off, I will call forth and excite, I will lead on and tempt|ἐξάγω]] [[along with|along with and in company with and together with, with, endued with, to, attended with, in accordance with, with and by means of|σύν]] [[to power|to power, to might, to strength, to ability, to authority, to force for war and forces, to quantity, to faculty and capacity, to force and meaning, to worth and value|δύναμις]] of me [[the people|the people, the men, the soldiers, the land-army, the common men, the folk, the Jews, the Christians|λαός]] of me the sons of [[name:Ισραηλ]] [[out of|out of, forth from, from|ἐκ]] [[of earth|of earth, of land, of ground|γῆ]] of [[name:Αἰγύπτου]] [[along with|along with and in company with and together with, with, endued with, to, attended with, in accordance with, with and by means of|σύν]] to an avenging [[to big|to big, to great, to tall, to full-grown, to vast and high, to spacious and wide, to strong and mighty, to violent, to loud, to prevailing, to weighty and important|μέγας]],

greek: καὶ γνώσονται πάντες οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι κύριος ἐκτείνων τὴν χεῖρα ἐπʼ Αἴγυπτον, καὶ ἐξάξω τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ ἐκ μέσου αὐτῶν.
hint: The Egyptians will know the lord when he stretches his hand over Egypt and brings Israel out from among them.

notes.text: Stretching out the hand, a participle, for the Hebrew binṭōtî ʾet-yādî, when I stretch out my hand.

reading: and [[will learn to know|will learn to know, will perceive, will mark, will learn, will discern and distinguish|γινώσκω]] [[all|all, the whole, every, every single|πᾶς]] the [[name:Αἰγύπτιοι]] [[that|that, seeing that, although, for that, because, inasmuch as|ὅτι]] I am [[lord|lord, master, the one having power and authority over|κύριος]] [[stretching out|stretching out, spreading out, putting forth|ἐκτείνω]] [[the hand|the hand, the hand and arm, the arm|χείρ]] [[upon|upon, on, in, at, near|ἐπί + accusative]] [[name:Αἴγυπτον]], and [[I will lead out|I will lead out, I will lead and carry out from, I will bring forth into the world, I will march out, I will eject, I will carry out and export, I will draw off, I will call forth and excite, I will lead on and tempt|ἐξάγω]] the sons of [[name:Ισραηλ]] [[out of|out of, forth from, from|ἐκ]] [[of middle|of middle, of in the middle, of the centre, of mid, of between two|μέσος]] of them.

greek: ἐποίησεν δὲ Μωυσῆς καὶ Ααρων, καθάπερ ἐνετείλατο αὐτοῖς κύριος, οὕτως ἐποίησαν.
hint: Moses and Aaron do exactly as the lord commanded.

notes.text: The singular, then the plural, of the same two.

reading: [[made|made, did, produced, created|ποιέω]] [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], [[name:Μωυσῆς]] and [[name:Ααρων]], [[according as|according as and just as, like as if and exactly as|καθάπερ]] [[enjoined|enjoined, commanded|ἐντέλλομαι]] to them [[lord|lord, master, the one having power and authority over|κύριος]], [[in this way|in this way, in this manner, so, thus, even so, so much|οὕτως]] [[made|made, did, produced, created|ποιέω]].

greek: Μωυσῆς δὲ ἦν ἐτῶν ὀγδοήκοντα, Ααρων δὲ ὁ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ ἐτῶν ὀγδοήκοντα τριῶν, ἡνίκα ἐλάλησεν πρὸς Φαραω.
hint: Moses is eighty and Aaron eighty-three when they speak to Pharaoh.

notes.text: Was of eighty years: the genitive of age, the numerals in its case.
The singular, with two persons named: the Hebrew has the plural, bĕdabbĕrām.

reading: [[name:Μωυσῆς]] [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], was, and kept on being as a standing and continuing condition and not a momentary one, of years of eighty, [[name:Ααρων]] [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], [[the son of the same mother|the son of the same mother, the brother, the near kinsman|ἀδελφός]] of him of years of eighty of three, [[at which time|at which time and when, since, whenever|ἡνίκα]] [[talked|talked, chatted, prattled, babbled, said, talked of, spoke, chattered, chirped|λαλέω]] [[toward|toward, facing, oriented to, in living motion and address toward|πρός + accusative]] [[name:Φαραω]].

greek: Καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν καὶ Ααρων λέγων
hint: The lord speaks to Moses and Aaron.

notes.text: Saying, opening the speech of the next verse, which Rahlfs prints with a capital.

reading: and [[said|said, spoke, declared, called by name, told|λέγω]] [[lord|lord, master, the one having power and authority over|κύριος]] [[toward|toward, facing, oriented to, in living motion and address toward|πρός + accusative]] [[name:Μωυσῆν]] and [[name:Ααρων]] [[saying|saying, speaking, declaring, calling by name, telling|λέγω]]

greek: Καὶ ἐὰν λαλήσῃ πρὸς ὑμᾶς Φαραω λέγων Δότε ἡμῖν σημεῖον ἢ τέρας, καὶ ἐρεῖς Ααρων τῷ ἀδελφῷ σου Λαβὲ τὴν ῥάβδον καὶ ῥῖψον αὐτὴν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ἐναντίον Φαραω καὶ ἐναντίον τῶν θεραπόντων αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔσται δράκων.
hint: If Pharaoh demands a sign, Aaron is to throw down his rod before him, and it will become a serpent.

notes.text: A dragon, a great serpent: the Hebrew has tannîn here, where 4:3 had nāḥāš, which the Greek gave as ὄφις.
Give us a sign or a wonder: the Hebrew has tĕnû lākem môpēt, give a wonder for yourselves.

reading: and [[if haply|if haply, if|ἐάν]] [[may talk|may talk, may chat, may prattle, may babble, may say, may talk of, may speak, may chatter, may chirp|λαλέω]] [[toward|toward, facing, oriented to, in living motion and address toward|πρός + accusative]] you [[name:Φαραω]] [[saying|saying, speaking, declaring, calling by name, telling|λέγω]] [[give|give, grant, provide, give over and deliver up|δίδωμι]] to us [[a sign|a sign, a mark and token, a sign from the gods and an omen, a signal, a standard and ensign, a boundary|σημεῖον]] [[or|or, either or, whether or, than and as, rather|ἤ]] [[a sign|a sign and wonder and marvel, a monster|τέρας]], and [[you will say|you will say, you will speak, you will declare, you will call by name, you will tell|λέγω]] to [[name:Ααρων]] [[to the son of the same mother|to the son of the same mother, to the brother, to the near kinsman|ἀδελφός]] of you [[take|take, receive, take hold of and grasp and seize|λαμβάνω]] [[the rod|the rod and wand and stick and switch, the magic wand, the fishing-rod, the limed twig, the spear-staff and shaft, the staff of office, the wand borne by the rhapsode (ῥαψῳδός), the rod for chastisement, the stripe and strip|ῥάβδος]] and [[throw|throw, cast, hurl, throw and toss about, cast out, throw off and away, throw away and waste, cast lots, throw and cast yourself down, fling yourself|ῥίπτω]] her [[upon|upon, on, in, at, near|ἐπί + accusative]] [[the earth|the earth, the land, the ground|γῆ]] [[in the presence of|in the presence of and before, opposite and face to face, against|ἐναντίον]] of [[name:Φαραω]] and [[in the presence of|in the presence of and before, opposite and face to face, against|ἐναντίον]] [[of the waiting-men|of the waiting-men and attendants, of the companions in arms, of the servants|θεράπων]] of him, and will be [[a dragon|a dragon and serpent, a python|δράκων]].

greek: εἰσῆλθεν δὲ Μωυσῆς καὶ Ααρων ἐναντίον Φαραω καὶ τῶν θεραπόντων αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐποίησαν οὕτως, καθάπερ ἐνετείλατο αὐτοῖς κύριος· καὶ ἔρριψεν Ααρων τὴν ῥάβδον ἐναντίον Φαραω καὶ ἐναντίον τῶν θεραπόντων αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐγένετο δράκων.
hint: Moses and Aaron do as commanded: Aaron throws down his rod before Pharaoh and his servants, and it becomes a serpent.

notes.lemma: ἐναντίον Φαραω καὶ τῶν θεραπόντων αὐτοῦ
notes.text: Before Pharaoh and his servants, at the first: the Hebrew has only ʾel-parʿōh, to Pharaoh.

reading: [[went in|went in, went into and entered, came into, came in, came upon|εἰσέρχομαι]] [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], [[name:Μωυσῆς]] and [[name:Ααρων]] [[in the presence of|in the presence of and before, opposite and face to face, against|ἐναντίον]] of [[name:Φαραω]] and [[of the waiting-men|of the waiting-men and attendants, of the companions in arms, of the servants|θεράπων]] of him and [[made|made, did, produced, created|ποιέω]] [[in this way|in this way, in this manner, so, thus, even so, so much|οὕτως]], [[according as|according as and just as, like as if and exactly as|καθάπερ]] [[enjoined|enjoined, commanded|ἐντέλλομαι]] to them [[lord|lord, master, the one having power and authority over|κύριος]]; and [[threw|threw, cast, hurled, threw and tossed about, cast out, threw off and away, threw away and wasted, cast lots, threw and cast himself down, flung himself|ῥίπτω]] [[name:Ααρων]] [[the rod|the rod and wand and stick and switch, the magic wand, the fishing-rod, the limed twig, the spear-staff and shaft, the staff of office, the wand borne by the rhapsode (ῥαψῳδός), the rod for chastisement, the stripe and strip|ῥάβδος]] [[in the presence of|in the presence of and before, opposite and face to face, against|ἐναντίον]] of [[name:Φαραω]] and [[in the presence of|in the presence of and before, opposite and face to face, against|ἐναντίον]] [[of the waiting-men|of the waiting-men and attendants, of the companions in arms, of the servants|θεράπων]] of him, and [[came into being|came to be, arose, was brought into existence|γίνομαι]] [[a dragon|a dragon and serpent, a python|δράκων]].

greek: συνεκάλεσεν δὲ Φαραω τοὺς σοφιστὰς Αἰγύπτου καὶ τοὺς φαρμακούς, καὶ ἐποίησαν καὶ οἱ ἐπαοιδοὶ τῶν Αἰγυπτίων ταῖς φαρμακείαις αὐτῶν ὡσαύτως.
hint: Pharaoh summons Egypt's wise men and sorcerers, and the Egyptian enchanters do the same by their arts.

notes.lemma: τοὺς σοφιστὰς … τοὺς φαρμακούς … οἱ ἐπαοιδοί
notes.text: For the Hebrew ḥăkāmîm, mĕkaššĕpîm and ḥarṭummîm: wise men, sorcerers, and magicians. ἐπαοιδός is ἐπῳδός uncontracted, filed there.
By their sorceries: the Hebrew has bĕlahăṭêhem, by their secret arts.

reading: [[called to council|called to council and convoked and convened, invited with others to|συγκαλέω]] [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], [[name:Φαραω]] [[the masters of one's craft|the masters of one's craft and art and adepts, the ones who are clever in matters of life and wise men, the Sophists, the sophists, the quibblers and cheats|σοφιστής]] of [[name:Αἰγύπτου]] and [[the poisoners|the poisoners and sorcerers and magicians, the ones who are sacrificed as an atonement, the scape-goats|φαρμακός]], and [[made|made, did, produced, created|ποιέω]] [[also|also and even, but, nay, and yet, as, likewise|καί]] [[the enchanters|the enchanters, the singing to and over, the acting as a charm for and against, the sung and said after, the called after, the verses and passages returning, the choruses and burdens and refrains|ἐπαοιδός]] of the [[name:Αἰγυπτίων]] [[to the uses of drugs|to the uses of drugs and potions and spells, to the poisonings and witchcrafts, to the remedies and cures|φαρμακεία]] of them [[in like manner|in like manner and just so|ὡσαύτως]].

greek: καὶ ἔρριψαν ἕκαστος τὴν ῥάβδον αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐγένοντο δράκοντες· καὶ κατέπιεν ἡ ῥάβδος ἡ Ααρων τὰς ἐκείνων ῥάβδους.
hint: Each throws down his rod and they become serpents, but Aaron's rod swallows theirs.

notes.text: The rod, the one of Aaron: the name after the repeated article, a genitive.
The rods of those: the demonstrative between the article and its noun.

reading: and [[threw|threw, cast, hurled, threw and tossed about, cast out, threw off and away, threw away and wasted, cast lots, threw and cast themselves down, flung themselves|ῥίπτω]] [[every|every, every one, each, each one, all and each one, singly and by itself, each by himself|ἕκαστος]] [[the rod|the rod and wand and stick and switch, the magic wand, the fishing-rod, the limed twig, the spear-staff and shaft, the staff of office, the wand borne by the rhapsode (ῥαψῳδός), the rod for chastisement, the stripe and strip|ῥάβδος]] of him, and [[came into being|came to be, arose, were brought into existence|γίνομαι]] [[dragons|dragons and serpents, pythons|δράκων]]; and [[gulped|gulped and swallowed down, drank in and imbibed, swallowed up and consumed, spent in tippling|καταπίνω]] [[the rod|the rod and wand and stick and switch, the magic wand, the fishing-rod, the limed twig, the spear-staff and shaft, the staff of office, the wand borne by the rhapsode (ῥαψῳδός), the rod for chastisement, the stripe and strip|ῥάβδος]], the one of [[name:Ααρων]], [[of those|of those, of the ones there, of the more remote|ἐκεῖνος]] [[the rods|the rods and wands and sticks and switches, the magic wands, the fishing-rods, the limed twigs, the spear-staffs and shafts, the staffs of office, the wands borne by the rhapsode (ῥαψῳδός), the rods for chastisement, the stripes and strips|ῥάβδος]].

greek: καὶ κατίσχυσεν ἡ καρδία Φαραω, καὶ οὐκ εἰσήκουσεν αὐτῶν, καθάπερ ἐλάλησεν αὐτοῖς κύριος.
hint: Pharaoh's heart prevails, and he does not listen, as the lord had said.

notes.text: Pharaoh's heart prevailed, κατισχύω, for the Hebrew wayyeḥĕzaq, was strong.
Spoke to them: the Hebrew has dibber YHWH, without them.

reading: and [[had power over|had power over and overpowered and prevailed against, came to its full strength|κατισχύω]] [[the heart|the heart, the stomach|καρδία]] of [[name:Φαραω]], and not [[hearkened|hearkened and gave ear to, heard, hearkened to and gave heed to|εἰσακούω]] of them, [[according as|according as and just as, like as if and exactly as|καθάπερ]] [[talked|talked, chatted, prattled, babbled, said, talked of, spoke, chattered, chirped|λαλέω]] to them [[lord|lord, master, the one having power and authority over|κύριος]].

greek: Εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν Βεβάρηται ἡ καρδία Φαραω τοῦ μὴ ἐξαποστεῖλαι τὸν λαόν.
hint: The lord tells Moses that Pharaoh's heart is weighed down against releasing the people.

notes.text: The perfect passive of βαρέω, has been weighed down, for the Hebrew kābēd, heavy.
The articular infinitive in the genitive: so as not to send away.

reading: [[said|said, spoke, declared, called by name, told|λέγω]] [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], [[lord|lord, master, the one having power and authority over|κύριος]] [[toward|toward, facing, oriented to, in living motion and address toward|πρός + accusative]] [[name:Μωυσῆν]] [[has been weighed down|has been weighed down and depressed and it stands so, has been weighed down and heavy and it stands so|βαρέω]] [[the heart|the heart, the stomach|καρδία]] of [[name:Φαραω]] [[not|not, that not, perhaps, surely not and you don't mean to say that|μή]] [[of the sending quite away|of the sending quite away, of the dispatching|ἐξαποστέλλω]] [[the people|the people, the men, the soldiers, the land-army, the common men, the folk, the Jews, the Christians|λαός]].

greek: βάδισον πρὸς Φαραω τὸ πρωί· ἰδοὺ αὐτὸς ἐκπορεύεται ἐπὶ τὸ ὕδωρ, καὶ στήσῃ συναντῶν αὐτῷ ἐπὶ τὸ χεῖλος τοῦ ποταμοῦ καὶ τὴν ῥάβδον τὴν στραφεῖσαν εἰς ὄφιν λήμψῃ ἐν τῇ χειρί σου.
hint: Moses is to meet Pharaoh at the river in the morning, holding the rod that became a serpent.

notes.text: The article over the adverb, an accusative of time: in the morning.

notes.text: βάτραχος, a frog: Middle Liddell's one translation, plain text.

reading: [[if|if, whether, come on|εἰ]] [[but|but, however, whereas, on the other hand|δέ]], [[not|not, that not, perhaps, surely not and you don't mean to say that|μή]] [[you will|you will, you wish and are willing, you mean, you profess and pretend and would fain, you prefer|βούλομαι]] you [[to send quite away|to send quite away, to dispatch|ἐξαποστέλλω]], [[lo|lo, behold, see there|ἰδού]] I [[I beat|I beat and strike and smite|τύπτω]] [[all|all, the whole, every, every single|πᾶς]] [[the boundaries|the boundaries and limits, the borders, the frontier|ὅριον]] of you to the frogs.

greek: καὶ ἐξερεύξεται ὁ ποταμὸς βατράχους, καὶ ἀναβάντες εἰσελεύσονται εἰς τοὺς οἴκους σου καὶ εἰς τὰ ταμίεια τῶν κοιτώνων σου καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν κλινῶν σου καὶ εἰς τοὺς οἴκους τῶν θεραπόντων σου καὶ τοῦ λαοῦ σου καὶ ἐν τοῖς φυράμασίν σου καὶ ἐν τοῖς κλιβάνοις σου·
hint: The river will teem with frogs that invade houses, bedrooms, beds, kneading troughs and ovens.

notes.text: ἐξερεύγομαι, which Middle Liddell gives only of rivers, to empty themselves: one translation, plain text.
Into the store-rooms of the bed-chambers, for the Hebrew ûbaḥădar miškābĕkā, into your bedroom. κοιτών, a bed-chamber, plain text.

reading: and will empty itself [[the river|the river and stream, the river-god|ποταμός]] frogs, and [[having gone up|having gone up, having mounted, having ascended, having gone up to, having risen, having come up, having come to and arrived at, having gone up country, having gone aboard|ἀναβαίνω]] [[will go in|will go in, will go into and enter, will come into, will come in, will come upon|εἰσέρχομαι]] [[into|into, to, in, rest in|εἰς]] [[the houses|the houses and abodes and dwellings, the rooms and chambers, the houses of a god and temples, the household goods and substances, the households and families|οἶκος]] of you and [[into|into, to, in, rest in|εἰς]] [[the treasuries|the treasuries, the magazines|ταμιεῖον]] of the bed-chambers of you and [[upon|upon, on, in, at, near|ἐπί + genitive]] [[of the things on which one lies|of the things on which one lies and couches, of the beds, of the biers|κλίνη]] of you and [[into|into, to, in, rest in|εἰς]] [[the houses|the houses and abodes and dwellings, the rooms and chambers, the houses of a god and temples, the household goods and substances, the households and families|οἶκος]] [[of the waiting-men|of the waiting-men and attendants, of the companions in arms, of the servants|θεράπων]] of you and [[of the people|of the people, of the men, of the soldiers, of the land-army, of the common men, of the folk, of the Jews, of the Christians|λαός]] of you and [[in the things which are mixed|within, inside of, and by means of the things which are mixed and kneaded and doughs|ἐν; φύραμα]] of you and [[in the earthen vessels|within, inside of, and by means of the earthen vessels and pans|ἐν; κλίβανος]] of you;

greek: καὶ ἐπὶ σὲ καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς θεράποντάς σου καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν λαόν σου ἀναβήσονται οἱ βάτραχοι.
hint: The frogs will come up on Pharaoh, his servants and his people.

notes.text: They will go up, for the Hebrew yaʿălû.

reading: and [[upon|upon, on, in, at, near|ἐπί + accusative]] you and [[upon|upon, on, in, at, near|ἐπί + accusative]] [[the waiting-men|the waiting-men and attendants, the companions in arms, the servants|θεράπων]] of you and [[upon|upon, on, in, at, near|ἐπί + accusative]] [[the people|the people, the men, the soldiers, the land-army, the common men, the folk, the Jews, the Christians|λαός]] of you [[will go up|will go up, will mount, will ascend, will go up to, will rise, will come up, will come to and arrive at, will go up country, will go aboard|ἀναβαίνω]] the frogs.
